skills.name: 袭阵
skills.text: 出牌阶段开始时，你可以选择一名其他角色，视为对其使用一张【杀】或【决斗】。此牌结算结束后，当你本阶段使用的牌被响应时，该角色回复1点体力，然后若其已受伤，则你摸一张牌，否则你摸两张牌。
notes: Launch: playPhaseStarting optional trigger; selectTarget otherLiving; chooseOption (owner picks slash or duel); the chosen branch executes useVirtualCard (normalSlashTarget) or startVirtualDuel; the XiZhen marker lands on the counterpart as the LAST instruction, i.e. after the virtual card fully settles, so the virtual card's own responses never pay the benefit.

Duel: BeginProgramVirtualDuel now accepts a play-phase trigger with one selected counterpart (the skill owner is the duel source) in addition to the classic two-target activation path (貂蝉离间 unchanged); the composition validator gained ReadVirtualDuelPair covering both shapes.

Benefit: a mandatory cardResponseAccepted trigger (ownerRelation observer) gated by the new cardActionOpponentIsOwner condition (a response action's OpponentSeat is the use actor) plus ownerIsTurnPlayer; the new xiZhenResponseBenefit op finds the single alive XiZhen holder, recovers it one, and draws the owner one if the holder is still wounded afterwards, otherwise two.

Expiry: the moushi-pattern turnEnding trigger (otherLiving) clears the marker at the holder's turn end; the follow-up is additionally gated by ownerIsTurnPlayer so it never fires outside the launch turn.

observations: OL lists 高览 as qun 4HP with quality 稀有; the page labels him 今我为刀俎（袭阵）.

New shared pieces: the trigger-path virtual duel (single counterpart + owner source), the ReadVirtualDuelPair composition resource, the cardActionOpponentIsOwner trigger condition, and the xiZhenResponseBenefit op (7163).
